edit.description: overlay_builtin_kind overlays the relocation row's guidance and cite when the row declares them

summary: explain and schema serve the counsel a relocation declares, not the built-in's it replaced
acceptance: a relocated built-in whose relocation declares guidance shows that guidance in explain and schema hover, matching the rule emit projects; a relocation declaring none is unchanged
tests: explain serves the guidance a relocation declares
notes: Seen by RELOCATION-DECLARES-GUIDANCE: the SDK writes the relocation's counsel to the kind-fact row; the overlay never reads those columns, so the two faces disagree.
